notes: German function words. queryStopWords: articles, pronouns, prepositions and question words left out of a criterion's search query, since they carry no topic. quantityFillers: prepositions, particles and connectors around an amount that do not change what is counted ('um 9', 'ca. 3', 'insgesamt 3', '2 Kinder und 1 Erwachsener'). alternativeMarkers: words that offer a choice of answers ('Montag oder Donnerstag'). rangeMarkers: words that extend an answer to another value ('18. Juli (bis 19. Juli)'); a note with either is part of the answer, but only a choice makes the whole answer ambiguous.
